Gradient Border Generator

Create gradient border effects with angle, colors, width and radius — live preview plus CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Set the border width, corner radius and gradient angle.
  2. Add color stops (one hex per line).
  3. Pick the inner background and preview box text.
  4. Copy the CSS or download it as gradient-border.css.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the gradient border work?

It uses a double-background trick: a solid background clipped to the padding box, and the gradient clipped to the border box, with a transparent border.

How many colors can I use?

Two or more — one hex color per line. Stops are spread evenly across the angle.

Will it work in all browsers?

Yes — background-clip with two layers works in all modern browsers.

Can I use it on images or buttons?

Yes — apply the .gb-box class to any element; adjust padding to taste.
